text:
If you've been waiting for a crisp, dry day to get outside, today's it. Sunny skies, a high right around 78, and that cool 54-degree start burns off fast under light north winds. The lake's laying down flat too, waves a foot or less, water sitting at a very swimmable 72, so it's a great day to be on or near it. Air's clean, UV is strong at midday, so bring the sunscreen if you're out for a while.

Saturday actually nudges a touch warmer, near 81, and starts sunny before clouds build in through the afternoon and evening as winds swing south. Still a solid morning-into-early-afternoon day for the water, with waves staying calm. The bigger story is Sunday, when showers and even a strong thunderstorm or two look likely to move in, so if you've got outdoor plans this weekend, front-load them into Saturday's daylight hours. Good waterfront window today lasts right through sunset near 7:48; I'd have Saturday's plans wrapped by mid-afternoon before the clouds roll in.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST: The weekend forecast is a bit of a mixed bag. Saturday looks to be the nicer of the two weekend days, with a good deal of sunshine especially to start the day, but we look to fade into more cloud cover by later Saturday afternoon and evening. High temperatures for the day are in the 70s to about 80. We start Sunday with clouds and scattered showers, but we will run the chance for a few thunderstorms into Sunday afternoon. There is the chance for a thunderstorm or two to be on the strong to severe side, with heavy rain, gusty winds and possibly some small hail. Temperatures are in the 70s for the day.
